title: Main-talk excerpt of the existing DPS interlock matrix
source_state: Working draft. We still need owner agreement and tests on the installed paths.

selected_rules.condition: LAr approaches the HV feedthrough shielding rim while drift HV is on
selected_rules.action: Shut down the drift HV supplies when the stated low-level condition is reached.
selected_rules.module_scope: FD-HD and FD-VD; map each module separately
selected_rules.stages: When the named equipment is powered; agree installation, test, cold and operating configurations.
selected_rules.stage_basis: Proposed applicability; stage approval not established.
selected_rules.limits: Baseline says level drops within 5 cm of the shielding ground-plane top rim. Confirm the reference, direction, calibration and uncertainty; response time is absent.
selected_rules.input_path: Source sensor/contact, cabinet, terminal or object, cable and I/O channel not mapped.
selected_rules.controller: Execution controller and interface not confirmed.
selected_rules.feedback: Map output to actual load and confirm equipment state independently of the command.
selected_rules.signal_loss: Invalid input, stale data, controller and power-loss responses need agreement.
selected_rules.recovery: Latch, reset authority and a separate re-enable decision need agreement.
selected_rules.decision: Map the actual level signal and relevant supplies; confirm current geometry and permitted delay.

selected_rules.condition: WIEC fan cooling is inadequate while BDE electronics are powered
selected_rules.action: Propose inhibiting the affected BDE low-voltage group after an agreed cooling-fault test. The released ICD defines interfaces, not this complete rule.
selected_rules.module_scope: FD-VD BDE; scope must be mapped to WIEC, PTC and supply channels.
selected_rules.stages: When the named equipment is powered; agree installation, test, cold and operating configurations.
selected_rules.stage_basis: Proposed applicability; stage approval not established.
selected_rules.limits: Fan voting, startup delay, command/status distinction and thermal response time are open. Historical X-of-4 voting leaves X undefined.
selected_rules.input_path: Released ICD requests proper-operation inputs from fan supply channels and bidirectional PTC status.
selected_rules.controller: Candidate DPS PLC/PTC path; S06 describes EtherCAT. S04 specifies individual PL506 channel inhibit/enable inputs, TTL 0–5 V on DSUB25. Confirm the output device, polarity and actual channel/interface mapping.
selected_rules.feedback: Map output to actual load and confirm equipment state independently of the command.
selected_rules.signal_loss: Invalid input, stale data, controller and power-loss responses need agreement.
selected_rules.recovery: Latch, reset authority and a separate re-enable decision need agreement.
selected_rules.decision: Agree cooling-fault definition, affected LV/bias outputs, timing and feedback.
selected_rules.inference: The interface supports an inhibit, and the historical design gates power on cooling. Applying that rule to FD-VD requires review.
